release_gates.reopen_condition: An official or rights-cleared PSDN source snapshot is staged with immutable revision/archive digests and reviewed license/notice metadata.
release_gates.statement: Exact PSDN source, immutable revision/archive/tree digest, and complete license/notice provenance must be identified and reviewed before any implementation claim.
release_gates.title: source_revision_archive_and_license_provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: All required model assets are staged with per-file byte counts, SHA-256, and reviewed weight/model-card/terms records.
release_gates.statement: Every required checkpoint/config/vocoder/speaker or accent asset must be pinned by byte count and SHA-256 with reviewed terms.
release_gates.title: weights_assets_and_terms

release_gates.reopen_condition: A locked runtime/install digest loads the pinned PSDN snapshot offline and records deterministic host/runtime settings.
release_gates.statement: A reproducible pinned runtime must load the exact snapshot offline with deterministic settings and no implicit download.
release_gates.title: pinned_runtime_and_offline_load

release_gates.reopen_condition: Signed consent/reference-availability/output-use records are staged for every required source, target, and reference condition.
release_gates.statement: Source-speaker consent, target/reference availability, and output-use terms are independent gates for every voice or accent condition.
release_gates.title: consent_reference_availability_and_output_use

release_gates.reopen_condition: A rights-cleared frozen cohort with manual transcripts, groups, and matched/mismatched/identity controls is staged and reviewed.
release_gates.statement: A frozen rights-cleared cohort with manual transcripts, language/speaker/accent groups, and matched controls must exist before any result.
release_gates.title: rights_cleared_accent_cohort_and_controls

release_gates.reopen_condition: Approved scorers and an independent blinded listening protocol produce reviewed separate outcomes on the frozen cohort.
release_gates.statement: Content preservation, identity/similarity, naturalness, and accent outcome must be measured separately with independent listening where required.
release_gates.title: separate_content_identity_naturalness_and_accent_outcomes

release_gates.reopen_condition: Target-device paced runs record alignment, first-output/tail, peaks, nonfinite behavior, CPU, memory, and deadline margins.
release_gates.statement: Alignment, first-output/tail timing, peaks, nonfinite behavior, device timing, resources, and deadlines must be measured, not inferred.
release_gates.title: alignment_first_output_tail_peaks_and_resources

release_gates.reopen_condition: A separate versioned intake passes independent exact-head review with OFF default and explicit release approval.
release_gates.statement: Opt-in provider intake, public-surface decision, independent exact-head review, and release approval are required before any exposure.
release_gates.title: provider_intake_public_surface_and_release
